traje_empieza.label: The process
traje_empieza.title: Your suit begins with you
traje_empieza.body: Before choosing a fabric or shaping a lapel, we need to know you. Your life moment, your personality, what you want to convey. Every suit we build is born from an honest conversation about who you are and who you want to be.

proceso.label: Our methodology
proceso.step1_body: What is the suit for? What do you want to convey? Everything begins with understanding the moment and the person.
proceso.step2_body: Every element we choose — lapel, shoulder, fabric, color — communicates something. We do it consciously and precisely.
proceso.step3_body: You won't see a suit. You'll see an elevated version of yourself. That is the difference between clothing and identity.

hero.label: The Atelier · Est. 1978
hero.subline: Four decades of craft in Madrid.

historia.label: The Story
historia.title: A Lifelong Vocation
historia.p1: In 1978, Manuel Fernández opened his first atelier in the heart of Madrid with a simple conviction: that well-made clothes change the way a man perceives himself.
historia.p2: He learned the craft from the great Spanish master tailors, absorbing not only the technique — the English cut, the hand-sewn canvas, the lapel that falls on its own — but also the philosophy: that every client deserves a unique garment.
historia.p3: Four decades later, nothing has changed. The same respect for the cloth, the same patience with the pattern, the same honest conversation before a single measurement is taken.

maestro.label: The Master
maestro.quote: A suit is not finished when the last stitch is sewn. It is finished when the person wearing it recognises in it a better version of themselves.
maestro.bio: With more than four decades dedicated to bespoke tailoring, Manuel Fernández has dressed executives, grooms and men at their most important moments. His Madrid atelier is, above all, a space for listening.

espacio.label: The Space
espacio.title: Where the Suit is Born
espacio.description: A private atelier in Madrid where every visit is an experience as carefully considered as the garment created within it.

filosofia.label: The Philosophy
filosofia.p1: At Sastrería Manuel Fernández, the process begins with questions, not measuring tape. We want to understand who you are, what moment you are living, what you want to communicate to the world.
filosofia.p2: The result is never just a suit. It is a tool of identity. A silent declaration. The most authentic version of yourself, sewn by hand.

editorial.title1: Every wedding is a story that begins in the atelier.
editorial.body1: When a client visits us for their wedding suit, they are not coming to choose a fabric. They are coming to build the image they will remember for the rest of their life.
editorial.title2: A wedding suit is remembered forty years later.
editorial.body2: The mother-of-pearl buttons, the embroidered lining, the lapel that defines character. Every decision is permanent. That is why we make them together, without haste.

proceso.label: The Wedding Process
proceso.title: From the first coffee to the final fitting.
proceso.step1_body: We talk about the day, the venue, the style. No catalogues, no pressure.
proceso.step2_body: Exclusive wools, silks and mohairs. Only the best for the best day.
proceso.step3_body: Multiple fitting sessions to guarantee the perfect fit well before the big day.
proceso.step4_body: Delivered with time to spare so it is truly yours before you wear it.
